basic_cases.name: Zoom 1.0 -> LOD 0
basic_cases.explanation: z_ideal = -log2(1.0) = 0. round(0) = 0. At 1:1 zoom, we need the highest resolution LOD 0.

basic_cases.name: Zoom 0.5 -> LOD 1
basic_cases.explanation: z_ideal = -log2(0.5) = 1. round(1) = 1. When zoomed out by 2x, we need LOD 1 (half resolution).

basic_cases.name: Zoom 0.25 -> LOD 2
basic_cases.explanation: z_ideal = -log2(0.25) = 2. round(2) = 2. When zoomed out by 4x, we need LOD 2 (quarter resolution).

basic_cases.name: Zoom 2.0 -> LOD 0 (clamped)
basic_cases.explanation: z_ideal = -log2(2.0) = -1. round(-1) = -1. Since LOD cannot be negative, it's clamped to 0.

basic_cases.name: Zoom 0.7 (rounds up) -> LOD 1
basic_cases.explanation: z_ideal = -log2(0.7) = 0.514. round(0.514) is 1. The ideal LOD is closer to 1 than 0.

basic_cases.name: Zoom 0.8 (rounds down) -> LOD 0
basic_cases.explanation: z_ideal = -log2(0.8) = 0.322. round(0.322) is 0. The ideal LOD is closer to 0 than 1.

hysteresis_cases.name: LOD 1, zoom 0.6, no change
hysteresis_cases.explanation: z_ideal = -log2(0.6) = 0.737. abs(0.737 - 1) = 0.263. This is less than 0.5 + 0.3 = 0.8, so LOD does not change.

hysteresis_cases.name: LOD 1, zoom 0.3, change to LOD 2
hysteresis_cases.explanation: z_ideal = -log2(0.3) = 1.737. abs(1.737 - 1) = 0.737. This is greater than 0.5 + 0.2 = 0.7, so LOD changes to round(1.737) = 2.

hysteresis_cases.name: LOD 0, zoom 0.6, change to LOD 1
hysteresis_cases.explanation: z_ideal = -log2(0.6) = 0.737. abs(0.737 - 0) = 0.737. This is greater than 0.5 + 0.2 = 0.7, so LOD changes to round(0.737) = 1.

hysteresis_cases.name: LOD 2, zoom 0.8, change to LOD 0
hysteresis_cases.explanation: z_ideal = -log2(0.8) = 0.322. abs(0.322 - 2) = 1.678. This is greater than 0.5 + 0.2 = 0.7, so LOD changes to round(0.322) = 0.
